# fireworks_secret (Resource)

An account-level secret. The API never returns the value, so it is kept in Terraform state (protect your state) and changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "wandb_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "fireworks_secret" "wandb" {
  secret_id = "wandb"
  key_name  = "WANDB_API_KEY"
  value     = var.wandb_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_name` (String) Name the secret is exposed under, e.g. WANDB_API_KEY.
- `secret_id` (String) Secret identifier, the last segment of the resource name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Secret value. Stored in state; never read back from the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as secret_id.
- `name` (String) Full resource name, e.g. accounts/my-account/secrets/my-secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The value can't be imported; the next apply writes the configured value.
terraform import fireworks_secret.wandb <secret-id>
```
